parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the value of **NextToken** that is returned in the last call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **PeerConnection**, which specifies a VPC peering connection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpcpeer list-tag-resources --resource-type PeerConnection --resource-id pcc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --max-results 50 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --category All --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpcpeer ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'pcc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000' --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Category All --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType PeerConnection --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
